_comment: The seven kinds of tale of the ATU index (Uther 2004) by number range. trilogy's atu_df.csv has each type's family (its 'division', e.g. 'Supernatural Helpers 500-559'), but its 'chapter' column files Realistic Tales and Tales of the Stupid Ogre under Religious Tales, so kinds are taken from here. 'families' fills the ranges atu_df.csv leaves without a division name and renames divisions whose name it cut short.

families.name: Supernatural or Enchanted Wife (Husband) or Other Relative
